an AfterToolCall denial withholds the result
model code never runs without isolation
model code cannot reach the filesystem outside its workspace
one goal per research; a batch is valid as a whole or not at all
a rejected event never reaches the log
G7 is set by an expert and by no one else
empty or out-of-bounds evidence does not verify
G8 reads stance and evidence level, not mere existence
agents read a frozen state and cannot emit above their principal
a state changed behind the log is detected and restored
retracted evidence stops supporting and voids the gates that used it
a report presents only hypotheses judged on their current version
finishing the tasks is not accepting the research
